Left with a ver slight pull to the left and the guy telling me that my car might ride differently because he set it up for tire wear, not performance like the factory. WHAT? They ended up fixing the pull but since there isn't a computer in the place and they didn't seem to fond of seeing me again I felt uncomfortable asking them to put it to factory settings. Now my car doesn't handle as well (honestly, there is a noticable difference) and I am force to go to another shop to get me back to factory specs.

message.content: The car still pulled slightly to the left. The mechanic told me he aligned it to reduce tire wear rather than for factory-spec performance. After I objected, they fixed the pull. However, the shop has no alignment computer, and the staff seemed annoyed by my return, so I did not feel comfortable asking them to restore the factory settings. My car now handles noticeably worse, and I have to pay another shop to align it to factory specifications.
